CALIBRATED (catalogue-based, Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5 — this is the calibrated probability, using the LBNL catalogue):

  0.73   -5.319     0.004922       0.0002155                   0.2809
  0.65   -5.281     0.01474        0.0006484                   0.4653

UPPER BOUND (DAS-based, uncalibrated magnitudes; every detection counted as an event at or above the catalogue Mc, so it over-counts):

Interpretation: the calibrated, catalogue-based probabilities of a Pohang-like Mw>=5.5 event are very low (1.2e-4 to 1.5e-2 per year depending on b), while the DAS-based upper bound (0.078/yr at b=0.9849) is an over-counting ceiling with uncalibrated magnitudes, not a calibrated estimate.
